Build a conditioning-window to target-age panel

Source: R/quant-condref.R
wgh_conditional_panel.Rd

For each child, takes the visit nearest a preferred anchor age within the conditioning window as the baseline, an optional second anchor for an annualised slope, and the visit nearest each target age (within a tolerance) as the outcome. This is the design of the conditional growth reference study (Ho 2026, medRxiv 2026.09.23.26363771). Children are not dropped for lacking the second anchor.

Usage

wgh_conditional_panel(
  x,
  window = c(5, 9),
  anchor = 6,
  anchor2 = 8,
  targets = c(12, 15, 18),
  tol = 1,
  outcome = "haz"
)

Arguments

x

Growth data with haz and baz.

window

Conditioning window in years.

anchor, anchor2

Preferred baseline age and optional second anchor.

targets

Target ages.

tol

Tolerance around each target age.

outcome

Outcome z-score (default "haz").

Value

One row per child and target age, with baseline_age, baseline_haz, baseline_baz, haz_slope, target_nominal, target_age, target (the outcome) and followup.

Examples

cp <- wgh_conditional_panel(growdat, targets = c(12, 15))
table(cp$target_nominal, cp$sex)
#>     
#>      Male Female
#>   12   93     83
#>   15    8      3
